description_en: Queries the top statistics of all traffic aggregated and sorted by various dimensions, including malicious requests and normal service traffic
description_zh: 查询所有流量按照不同维度聚合统计并进行排序后的top统计数据，包含恶意请求和正常的业务请求
kebab_example:
aliyun waf-openapi describe-network-flow-topn-metric --instance-id 'waf_cdnsdf3****
' --filter '{"DateRange":{"StartDate":1713888000,"EndDate":1713888600}}' --limit 10 --metric matched_host_by_upstream_status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeNetworkFlowTopNMetric

parameters.help_en: The number of data entries to return after the statistics are sorted in descending order. Maximum value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 控制统计数据按照降序排序后返回数据条数，最大值为10
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en:
The metric used to distinguish the returned data content. Different metrics correspond to different data content. The metrics supported by this operation are as follows: real_client_ip: aggregates and sorts all requests of the current user that pass through WAF by the source IP address of the request in descending order, and returns the top N data entries. http_user_agent: aggregates and sorts all requests of the current user that pass through WAF by the User-Agent of the request in descending order, and returns the top N data entries. request_path: aggregates and sorts all requests of the current user that pass through WAF by the URL of the request in descending order, and returns the top N data entries. matched_host_by_total_requests: returns the top N protected objects with the largest number of requests for the current user and the corresponding number of requests. matched_host_by_qps: returns the top N protected objects with the highest QPS for the current user and the corresponding QPS data. matched_host_by_status: when this metric is used, you must specify status in the Conditions field of Filter. WAF aggregates and sorts the data whose HTTP response code returned by WAF is equal to the status specified in Conditions by protected object, and returns the top N data entries. The format for specifying status is as follows:
{"Key":"status","OpValue":"eq","Values":"200"} matched_host_by_upstream_status: when this metric is used, you must specify upstream_status in the Conditions field of Filter. WAF aggregates and sorts the data whose HTTP response code returned by the origin server is equal to the upstream_status specified in Conditions by protected object, and returns the top N data entries. The format for specifying upstream_status is as follows:
{"Key":"upstream_status","OpValue":"eq","Values":"200"}
parameters.help_zh:
用于区分返回的数据内容，不同的Metric对应不同的数据内容，该接口支持的Metric如下： real_client_ip，当前用户所有经过waf的请求，按照请求源IP聚合统计并降序排序后，返回前N条数据。 http_user_agent，当前用户所有经过waf的请求，按照请求的user-agent聚合统计并降序排序后，返回前N条数据。 request_path，当前用户所有经过waf的请求，按照请求的URL聚合统计并降序排序后，返回前N条数据。 matched_host_by_total_requests，返回当前用户请求数最大的N个防护对象以及对应的请求数。 matched_host_by_qps，返回当前用户QPS最大的N个防护对象以及对应的QPS数据 matched_host_by_status，使用该Metric时需要在Filter的Conditions字段指定status，waf返回的HTTP响应码等于Conditions中指定的status的数据按照防护对象聚合统计并排序后，返回前N条数据。指定status的格式如下：
{"Key":"status","OpValue":"eq","Values":"200"} matched_host_by_upstream_status，使用该Metric时需要在Filter的Conditions字段指定upstream_status，源站返回的HTTP响应码等于Conditions中指定的upstream_status的数据按照防护对象聚合统计并排序后，返回前N条数据。指定upstream_status的格式如下：
{"Key":"upstream_status","OpValue":"eq","Values":"200"}
parameters.name: metric
